channel.title: Second Date Questions
channel.description:
Short episodes with good questions to ask on a second date, grouped by theme: easy openers, curiosity, values and fun. Each episode also has one tip for keeping the conversation balanced.

Made by Honest Little Apps, the makers of SecondYes: Second Date Planner, an iPhone app to plan and agree on a second date in a few taps. SecondYes: Second Date Planner on the App Store

Narrated with a synthetic (text-to-speech) voice.
